Its A/B evidence stands on its own (whole-tree: only K44/K45 removed, 0 added; exhaustive check: NEW hit set is always a subset of OLD).

k57Conclusion.verdict: PER-FUNCTION: TM600_HS_RDSON MUST KEEP K57_CAP_BST_SW closed (both the rule layer and the engineering layer require it). TM601_LS_RDSON is exempted at the rule layer and may run zero-Cap-closure, but keeping K57 closed is harmless. Net instruction to the payload: change nothing - test.cpp already closes K57 in both functions, which is correct.

ruleLayer.TM600: REQUIRED - its powered rail token is BST_SW, and the exemption set (mi_pins) contains only SW, so fam_intersect({'SW'},'BST_SW') is empty; deleting K57 would raise a new FR-001 warning.
ruleLayer.TM601: NOT REQUIRED - both its powered rail token (SW) and its mi_pins (PMID_SW, SW) meet the SW_BST alias, so the exemption fires.

engineeringLayer.statement: K57 is genuinely justified for TM600

a later revision said the reverse check no longer requires K57 for TM600 as well - also WRONG, corrected here after rule-reviewer's token-level analysis, which I re-derived independently.

regenerationBehaviour.question: t22 UNKNOWN 3 - does re-running the metadata generator overwrite the run-scope correction?
regenerationBehaviour.answer: YES. The override is NOT durable across regeneration.
regenerationBehaviour.method: scripts/gen_testitems_meta.py --out <probe file> (the live meta was NOT overwritten), then a field-by-field compare of TM600_HS_RDSON / TM601_LS_RDSON.
regenerationBehaviour.keyFinding: the regenerated file is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the pre-override meta (the same hash as the 'before' value of this task), i.e. regeneration restores vbat 3.5 / pmid 5 (TM600), vset vbus (TM601), VBUS in powered_pins and EMPTY mi_pins.
consequences: any pipeline re-run (gen_testitems_meta.py and/or gen_test_conditions.py) silently wipes this run-scope fix;
the two reds it removed (TM601 SW->K57_CAP_BST_SW and TM601 VBUS->K5_VBUS_Cap) would come back;

therefore the fix must either be re-applied as an explicit post-generation step recorded in the implementation manifest, or be landed in the generator (scripts/gen_testitems_meta.py is OUT of t26 scope), or be protected by a gate assertion.

recommended guard: assert for TM600/TM601 that hardwareInit vset matches the frozen ATE (4.2/15/5/5 and 4.2/9/5), that no simulation-domain rail appears, and that mi_pins contains the measured current pin - so a silent revert turns red instead of passing quietly.
regenerationBehaviour.determinismNote: the probe also proves the generator is deterministic: its output reproduces the pre-override meta byte-for-byte.
